title: English in a Minute: In Full Swing

transcript.text: Welcome to English in a Minute.
A swing moves back and forth.
But what does it mean if something is in full swing?
So are you feeling excited now that the holidays are in full swing?
I'm always the one planning everything.
The food, the shopping, the decorations.
It sounds like your holiday stress levels are in full swing too.
When a time of year or activity is in full swing, it is at its highest level of activity
and no longer at the beginning stages.
